columns.body: ZOLLER collaborates with industry partners to provide the best solutions for our customers' needs.

blocks.body:
ANCA is a market leader in quality CNC grinding machines and CNC systems. The company has continued to evolve through a strategy based on innovation and technology, as well as a determination to produce machines that satisfy customers and exceed their expectations.

ZOLLER offers an interface for ANCA tool grinding machines.

With more than 35 years of experience, A+B Solutions offers comprehensive expertise in the project planning and integration of solutions for recording and controlling production. As a solution partner of leading providers such as Siemens PLM Software, A+B Solutions offers its customers complete solutions: from consulting, planning and project planning to system integration and service.

A+B Solutions' solutions offer interfaces for a wide range of applications and — as the central hub for all development, order, and production data — create a consistent and standardized data structure. A+B Solutions is ZOLLER's development partner for connecting our systems to Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

With over 50 years of sensor experience, Balluff GmbH is one of the world's most efficient and leading manufacturers of sensor technology for industrial automation. The company is known for its application-specific customer solutions, individual advice, first-class service, sophisticated technology ,and state-of-the-art electronics — all thoroughly tested in its own certified laboratory

Balluff and ZOLLER cooperate in the field of tool data transfer through tool coding and tool identification.

Camaix provides services in mold making, mechanical engineering and vehicle construction. It has been particularly involved in aerospace technology and complex 5-axis and 6-axis machining in recent years, for which it has developed special solutions.

The simple and intuitive Mastercam interfaces with ZOLLER tool management to enable programming in Mastercam with current tool geometries of the assembled tools and uses the data for simulation and collision control.

Camtek GmbH in Weinstadt near Stuttgart was founded in 1993 as the sole distributor of the PEPS CAD/CAM system. In close cooperation with well-known machine and control manufacturers, high-quality postprocessors are developed and both systems are continuously improved.

ZOLLER offers you a convenient and easy-to-use interface to the PEPS CAD/CAM system.

Delcam is one of the world's leading developers and suppliers of advanced CAD/CAM and device-independent 3D measurement software for the manufacturing industry. Delcam is the largest developer of CAD/CAM software in the UK and has offices in North America, Europe and Asia. Its products are used by more than 50,000 companies in over 80 countries, and include the world's leading CAM software PowerMILL.

PowerMILL interface with the ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions to give you convenient access to the extensive ZOLLER database.

DP Technology is one of the leading manufacturers and suppliers of computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) software for a wide range of industries. ESPRIT, DP Technology's flagship product, is an extremely powerful and high quality NC programming system for milling, drilling, turning, wire EDM and for multi-function machines like mill-turn centers.

The simple and intuitive ESPRIT CAM interfaces with the ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions to enable the easy exchange of tool data.

Virtual Gibbs is a powerful, flexible CAM software that significantly simplifies CNC programming. The user-friendly interface increases productivity and makes it ideal for CNC programmers, machinists and engineers. With support for 2D to 5-axis milling, turning, MTM and wire EDM, Virtual Gibbs enables fast and reliable programming. Virtual Gibbs is the leading CAM solution for programming complex multi-channel machining centers. Thanks to the ZOLLER interface in Virtual Gibbs, tools are created centrally and only once, ensuring efficiency and consistency.

Hermle machining centers are used for efficient machining of tools, molds, and series parts. Thanks to their quality and high precision, they are used in countless production areas, particularly in demanding sectors such as medical technology, the optical industry, the aerospace and automotive industries, and tool and mold making — as well as their suppliers.

ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machines have an optional interface to Hermle machining centers.

Ingersoll develops and produces indexable insert-tipped standard and special tools for machining. The tools are used worldwide, especially in the automotive and mechanical engineering industries. In addition to the standard range, Ingersoll develops and designs sophisticated solutions according to customer requirements.

ZOLLER has worked with Ingersoll to develop, among other things, a new concept for workshop-friendly testing and measuring of indexable insert-tipped hobbing cutters and tooth form cutters.

With innovative tool concepts and holistic solutions for bore machining, the KOMET CERATIZIT GROUP is a global technology leader. KOMET customers particularly appreciate its pioneering services, unique technical support, practice-oriented specialist seminars and premium tools for drilling, reaming, and threading.

ZOLLER offers presetting and measuring tool solutions from the KOMET CERATIZIT GROUP.

KROMI Logistik AG offers manufacturing companies in Germany and abroad complete outsourcing of precision tools, with a focus on technically sophisticated cutting tools for metal and plastics processing.

The TMS Tool Management Solutions SILVER package includes the KROMI interface.

MAKINO is recognized as one of the leading technology and service providers in the machine tool industry. Its product range includes machining centers for parts production as well as for tool and mold making with a wide range of applications in the aerospace, automotive, agricultural and construction machinery, general engineering, and microtechnology sectors.

ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machines have the option of interfacing with MAKINO machining centers.

Based on the CAD/CAM - TopSolid product range, MOLDTECH offers solutions for the machining industry. With services related to the TopSolid product range, Moldtech supports users in making demanding design and production tasks faster and more effective.

The simple and intuitive TopSolid'Cam interfaces with ZOLLER tool management, enabling you to program in TopSolid'Cam with current tool geometries of the assembled tools and to use the data for simulation and collision control.

MTS AG develops and distributes software for CNC grinding machines. Its "tool-kit PROFESSIONAL" product is known worldwide as the professional software for producing and resharpening simple to complex workpieces.

ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machines offer an interface to tool grinding machines equipped with the software solution from MTS.

NUM manufactures CNC controls and machining software solutions. NUM is the market leader in the tool grinding field with its NUMROTOplus software.

ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machines offer an interface to tool grinding machines equipped with the NUMROTOplus software solution.

Okuma is a leading supplier of innovative machine tools with a broad and impressive product range. This includes highly accurate and robust NC lathes, multifunctional machines, and machining centers equipped with its outstanding OSP control.

ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machines offer an optional interface to Okuma machine tools.

OPEN MIND Technologies AG develops and distributes innovative CAM/CAD solutions that generate optimal NC milling and turning programs for machine tools based on digital models. Manufacturers from a wide range of industries around the world choose OPEN MIND products because they enable economic and efficient manufacturing. The company creates models, prototypes, tools, molds, prismatic workpieces, integral components, and more — all in impressive quality.

The hyperMILL® interface in the ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions gives you convenient access to the extensive ZOLLER database.

OPUS® has been supplying task-oriented solutions for CAM, MDE and DNC for over 30 years. Well over 4000 installations in almost 1000 companies speak for themselves. OPUS® is adapted precisely to production requirements and further developed with user collaboration.

The simple and intuitive OPUS solutions interface with ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions, enabling simple data transfer between the ZOLLER database and the OPUS CAM system.

Saacke, an innovative family-owned company with over 100 years of experience, sets trends worldwide with tool grinding machines and gear cutting and profile tools.

ZOLLER presetting and measuring machines offer an optional interface to Saacke tool grinding machines.

Siemens PLM Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Factory Division, is a leading global provider of software, systems, and services for product lifecycle management (PLM) and manufacturing operations management (MOM). It has more than 15 million licensed users and over 140,000 customers worldwide.

As a Siemens Software & Technology Partner, ZOLLER interfaces with Siemens Teamcenter to transfer target and actual data from ZOLLER presetting, measuring and inspection machines to the machine tool and integrated product development and production software suite, Siemens NX. This enables secure data exchange with the TMS Tool Management Solutions via the ZOLLER tool database z.One.

SOFLEX introduced the first flexible manufacturing systems in Germany and, as a spin-off from the University of Stuttgart, has been involved in the exciting and challenging industrial sector from the very beginning. Since 1984, SOFLEX's control systems—including cell and production control—have been its core competence. SOFLEX receives valuable impetus from a broad network of universities and colleges.

The ZOLLER tool presetting and measuring machine includes an interface to SOFLEX so that planning orders can be transferred to the ZOLLER machine. In addition, the presetting and measuring machine automatically requests the tool requirements list via the ZOLLER-SOFLEX-PCS interface. After setting on the ZOLLER presetting and measuring machine, the measured data is forwarded directly to the SOFLEX-PCS system and then SOFLEX-PCS transfers the tool data to the machine when the tool is loaded.

SolidCAM is one of the leading international providers of integrated CAD/CAM systems for efficient CAM programming in the mechanical manufacturing, electronics, medical, consumer goods, machine development, automotive and aerospace industries as well as in mold and tool making. With its SolidCAM and InventorCAM products, SolidCAM offers seamless integration into Solidworks and Autodesk Inventor. The software with the revolutionary, patented iMachining technology and SolidCAM MillTurn plus supports the entire range of CNC applications up to complex turn-mill centers and sliding headstock lathes.

The simple and intuitive SolidCAM interface with ZOLLER tool management enables convenient access to the extensive ZOLLER tool database via TMS Tool Management Solutions. Complete tools for milling, turning and turn-milling can be used as 3D tool data directly in SolidCAM for simulation and collision checking.

Since the machine tool manufacturer was founded in 1922, TAKISAWA has been known for its pioneering spirit and passion. With an enormous wealth of experience and more than 100 years in business, TAKISAWA offers a wide range of innovative and technologically advanced products.

ZOLLER provides an interface for tool data transfer to TAKISAWA.

Tebis AG is one of the global market and technology leaders in the CAD/CAM and MES sector. With Tebis software, customers design, plan and manufacture high-quality models, molds and components efficiently and reliably. Teams of experienced consulting and implementation specialists develop strategies for CAD/CAM processes and implement them for customers, ensuring a sustainable technological and competitive advantage. Automation has been Tebis' formula for success for over 30 years. For its customers, Tebis sees itself as a pioneer in the direction of Industry 4.0.

The simple and intuitive Tebis interface to ZOLLER TMS Tool Management Solutions enables easy transfer of tool data and setup sheets—including individual components and complete tools—between the ZOLLER tool database z.One and the Tebis CAM system.

The Vollmer Group is successful worldwide as a specialist for tool processing in production and service with an extensive range of machines. The technology leader's product range includes state-of-the-art grinding, eroding, and processing machines for rotary tools, circular saws, and band saws for the wood and metalworking industry.

ZOLLER presetting and measuring machines can be perfectly networked through an interface to Vollmer sanding machines.

YOUR COMPANION FOR INTEGRATIVE PLM

At DSC Software AG, we are passionate about bringing people, processes, and systems together. Our hearts beat for your product data.

Get inspired by our fascination with integration. Committed to innovation, empathy, and partnership, we accompany you in the concrete implementation of your digitalization strategy: with SAP as the central, digital data basis for your business processes, enhanced with tailor-made best-practice solutions.

As a long-term SAP partner, we stand by your side as an experienced and fantastically connected companion. Our team combines more than 1,100 years of PLM know-how directed to one single goal: creating the best possible solution to your individual challenges. We help you convert your brilliant ideas into smart products even more quickly and keep being ready for the future.
